criterion: Duplicate the control rows for each incident, record minimum evidence, and never place secrets, full prompts or personal data in this file.
record_here: Use one row per criterion; mark Compliant only when you have consultable evidence.
example: This file is a template; EXAMPLE-001 is fictional.

criterion: Run ID, current version and known-good baseline are recorded.
Owner, backup and authority to contain are defined.
example: owner: product-ops; backup: platform-oncall; authority: pause-tool

criterion: Signal, first-seen time, affected window and trace/log links are recorded.
Severity, external effect, scope, reversibility and escalation duty are classified.
example: SEV-2; no external write; 18 failed suggestions; reversible; platform owner notified

criterion: The tool, version, traffic or safe mode that prevents new actions is identified and tested.
example: Paused invoice-write tool; traffic switched to suggestion mode; verified in staging

criterion: Required approval or rejection, authority and expiry are recorded.
example: No approval needed for containment; restore requires platform lead approval

criterion: Checkpoint, completed step, idempotency key and replay limit are recorded.
example: checkpoint cp-184; last completed: classify; key: EXAMPLE-001; replay: 0

criterion: Alternative path, capability loss and degradation communication are documented.
example: Manual queue; 30-minute delay; user-facing degraded-mode notice

criterion: Each effect already executed has a receipt, before/after state and compensation or reconciliation path.
example: No external effect; reconciliation not required; confirmed by destination audit

criterion: Baseline, validation cases, approver, restoration time and exit criterion are recorded.
example: Restored agent-v3.2; 12 regression cases passed; approved by platform lead; traffic reopened at 10:42Z

criterion: Confirmed cause, regression test, owner, due date and effectiveness check are defined.
example: Cause: tool timeout loop; add bounded retry test; owner: platform; due: 2026-08-24; review after 7 days
